title: Ema Datshi (Bhutanese chilli and cheese stew)

ingredients.name: large mild green chillies, slit lengthwise
soft fresh cheese such as farmer's cheese or crumbled feta, and a little mild cheddar
salt to taste, if the cheese is not salty

steps: Put the chillies, onion, tomato, garlic, butter and water in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for about 10 minutes until the chillies are tender.
Crumble in the cheese and stir gently.
Cook for 5 to 7 minutes more until the cheese melts into a thick, creamy sauce and the oil is shining on the surface.
Taste and adjust the salt, and serve hot with plenty of steamed rice (traditionally red rice).

source.name: Wikipedia
source.note: Original write-up of a traditional preparation, made for World Recipes. Quantities are approximate; adjust to taste.

title: Hoentay (Bhutanese buckwheat dumplings with greens and cheese)
steps: Mix the buckwheat flour with the salt, then add the warm water a little at a time and knead into a smooth, firm dough, adding a spoonful of plain flour if it cracks. Rest it for 20 minutes.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the onion and ginger until soft.
Add the greens and cook until wilted and dry, then take off the heat and stir in the cheese, chilli powder and salt.
Roll the dough into thin rounds about 8 cm wide, and put a spoonful of filling in the middle of each.
Fold the dough over and pleat or pinch the edges tightly to seal.
Steam the dumplings in a lightly oiled steamer for 12 to 15 minutes and serve hot with chilli sauce.

title: Kewa Datshi (Bhutanese potatoes in cheese sauce)

ingredients.name: soft fresh cheese such as farmer's cheese or crumbled feta

steps: Put the potatoes, onion, chillies and butter in a pot with the water and a little salt.
Bring to a boil, cover and cook for 10 to 12 minutes until the potatoes are nearly tender.
Stir in the tomato, then crumble in the cheese.
Simmer, stirring gently, for about 5 minutes until the cheese has melted into a creamy sauce that coats the potatoes.
Serve hot with rice.

title: Shamu Datshi (Bhutanese mushrooms in cheese sauce)

ingredients.name: soft fresh cheese such as farmer's cheese or crumbled feta

steps: Heat the butter in a pot and soften the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and chillies and cook for about 5 minutes until they release their juices.
Pour in the water, bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Crumble in the cheese and stir gently until it melts into a thick sauce, about 5 minutes more.
Season to taste and serve hot with steamed rice.
